title: Real SBOM support PSTF, deterministic tests, and user documentation
observed_context: Completed SBOM implementation epics bahia-1qe9.1 through bahia-1qe9.7 introduced canonical SBOM event contracts, subject-neutral domain/projection storage, parser and attestation refactors, Syft/cdxgen generator adapters, Blossom storage, Nostr 30078/30004 publication with relay OK verification, orchestration service status/audit publication, ContextVM methods, REST compatibility import, and compatibility read projections.

docs/designs/sbom-real-support.md defines the intended canonical flow: ContextVM sbom/generate or sbom/import intent, status progression, real generation/import, Blossom upload and hash verification, 30078 SBOM reference publication, 30004 availability-list publication, projection, audit, and completed status.
Existing UI E2E coverage verifies artifact SBOM detail rendering, empty state behavior, SBOM policy builder behavior, and canonical SBOM event filtering.
Existing REST compatibility tests verify POST /artifacts/{id}/sbom delegates to the import service, requires that service, and preserves hash-idempotent compatibility reads.
intended_behavior: Bahia generates or imports real SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM payloads for artifact, deployment, package, and repository subjects; stores generated/imported payload bytes on Blossom; verifies payload hashes; publishes accepted 30078 SBOM reference events and complete accepted 30004 availability lists; emits event-driven 30315 status and 4903 audit facts; keeps REST and MCP surfaces as compatibility/read-model conveniences; and documents the workflow for users and operators.
scope: PSTF artifacts, deterministic unit/integration/E2E test mapping, narrow missing tests, and user documentation for artifacts, packages, deployments, Nostr integration, and MCP SBOM tools.
